headline: New Scientist reports that Russia and China are using AI in persistent cyberattacks against the UK.
score_reason: Pool score 6 lowered by 1: article not readable and the claim rests on the headline alone; the UK government's related announcement was on 12 Oct.
importance_line: British organisations and the public may face AI-assisted cyberattacks backed by foreign states, but the evidence behind the claim and who made it are not yet clear.
summary: New Scientist reports that Russia and China are using AI to stage persistent cyberattacks against the UK.
notes: Headline only; page blocked (HTTP 406). A UK government release of 12 Oct 2026 on AI defences exists but was not used as the source for the claim.
